mapper.sql:
where delete_flg = 'N' and published_dtm >= #{startDate} and published_dtm < date_add(#{endDate}, interval 1 day)
and status in
#{status}
and title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
and tags_json like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
and status like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
and ( title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or tags_json like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or status like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
mapper.select:
select news_seq as newsSeq, title, slug, category, status, date(published_dtm) as publishedDate, date(reg_dtm) as registeredDate, date(mod_dtm) as updatedDate from bd_ai_news_mst
order by published_dtm desc, news_seq desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select news_seq as newsSeq, slug, title, category, summary, content, tags_json as tagsJson, source_url as sourcesJson, status, delete_flg as deleteFlg, date(published_dtm) as publishedDate, null as sourceFile, null as crawlError, reg_dtm as registeredAt, reg_id as registeredBy, mod_dtm as modifiedAt, mod_id as modifiedBy from bd_ai_news_mst where news_seq = #{newsSeq} and delete_flg = 'N'

select news_seq as newsSeq, slug, title, category, summary, content, tags_json as tagsJson, source_url as sourcesJson, status, delete_flg as deleteFlg, date(published_dtm) as publishedDate, null as sourceFile, null as crawlError, reg_dtm as registeredAt, reg_id as registeredBy, mod_dtm as modifiedAt, mod_id as modifiedBy from bd_ai_news_mst where news_seq = #{newsSeq} and status = 'Y' and delete_flg = 'N'

select news_seq as newsSeq, slug, title, category, summary, content, tags_json as tagsJson, source_url as sourcesJson, status, delete_flg as deleteFlg, date(published_dtm) as publishedDate, null as sourceFile, null as crawlError, reg_dtm as registeredAt, reg_id as registeredBy, mod_dtm as modifiedAt, mod_id as modifiedBy from bd_ai_news_mst where slug = #{slug} and delete_flg = 'N'
mapper.insert: insert into bd_ai_news_mst ( slug, title, category, summary, content, tags_json, source_url, published_dtm, status, delete_flg, reg_dtm, reg_id, mod_dtm, mod_id ) values ( #{slug}, #{title}, #{category}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{tagsJson}, #{sourcesJson}, #{publishedDate}, #{status}, 'N', current_timestamp, #{actorId}, current_timestamp, #{actorId} )
mapper.update: update bd_ai_news_mst set slug = #{slug}, title = #{title}, category = #{category}, summary = #{summary}, content = #{content}, tags_json = #{tagsJson}, source_url = #{sourcesJson}, published_dtm = #{publishedDate}, status = #{status}, mod_dtm = current_timestamp, mod_id = #{actorId} where news_seq = #{newsSeq} and delete_flg = 'N'
update bd_ai_news_mst set delete_flg = 'Y', mod_dtm = current_timestamp where news_seq = #{newsSeq}
